xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for blocking repo-controlled descendant symlinks during TS deposit copy.

plan.title: Block descendant symlink escapes during TypeScript deposit copy

narratives.Overview: The scheduled application-security review found that directive init/update guard the .deft/core boundary but do not inspect existing descendant paths before copying @deftai/directive-content into that tree. A malicious repository can pre-create .deft/core child symlinks pointing outside the checkout, causing the copy primitive to overwrite and chmod external files through standard destination-symlink following.
narratives.Action: Make the TypeScript copy-tree deposit primitive refuse destination symlinks before writing or chmoding files, and add regression coverage for the external-target overwrite case.
narratives.Test: Run focused deposit tests, build, and changed-file lint before opening the PR. The full repository gate was also attempted; it failed in unrelated session/story/swarm/value tests that are outside this scoped deposit change.

items.title: copyTree refuses a destination file path that is already a symlink.

narrative.Acceptance: A crafted .deft/core child symlink is not followed, its external target remains unchanged, and copyTree rejects the copy with a clear error.

items.title: Existing source-symlink and mode-preservation behavior remains covered.

narrative.Acceptance: Existing copyTree tests still pass alongside the new destination-symlink regression.
